title: Doesn't have any smell
text: Doesn't have any smell. Doesn't smell like mimosa, in fact, doesn't smell like anything.

product_metadata.title: Home Locomotion 12010634 Mimosa Scented Candle, Multicolor
description: No need to be over 21! Our mimosa-scented Highball Candle, part of our Cocktail Lounge, will delight your nose, not your palate. It might look like the popular drink, given its dark yellow color, easily viewed through clear glass, but that's where the similarities end. This gorgeous candle is made from hand-poured soy blend wax. Its mimosa scent opens with a fresh burst of juicy orange and lime, followed by a heart that flows with ginger and is layered by bubbly champagne. Cheers to all!Lead and tin free cotton wick.Burn time: 33 Hours.
